Project Overview
PDE Model: ∂C/∂t = D∇²C − kC + S(x) − F(x)
D = diffusion  ·  k = decay  ·  S = sources  ·  F = filters

Objective: minimise ∫∫ C(x,t) dx over Bengaluru grid
using ADMM + Gradient Descent filter placement.
